snippet.title: Scarlet Hollow Episode 3 Trailer
snippet.description:
Episode 3 of our supernatural horror mystery game Scarlet Hollow is coming out on March 7th on Steam and Itch!

Play Episode 1 for free before then: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1406040/Scarlet_Hollow__Episode_1/
Play Episodes 1 *and* 2 in early access: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1609230/Scarlet_Hollow/
Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/blacktabbygames
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/xCnAeqkkEY
